history.summary: A branch centre of the Ramakrishna Mission (Hindu-organization ashram with a prayer hall/temple) at Ramakrishna Mission Road, Mokdumpur, English Bazar, Malda. Traces its origin to the visit of Swami Premananda, a disciple of Sri Ramakrishna, to Malda in 1914 for Sri Ramakrishna's birthday celebration; local listings date the ashram to 1924 (flag: exact affiliation date not verified). It runs the Ramakrishna Mission Vivekananda Vidyamandir school, serving Malda for ~80 years. Festivals listed are standard Ramakrishna Mission observances (verify local calendar).

name: Ramakrishna Math and Mission Ashrama, Malda
town_description: Malda (English Bazar) is the district headquarters of Malda district in northern West Bengal, a historic city on the Mahananda river near the ruins of Gaur.

travel.airport: Bagdogra Airport (~250 km) or Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose International Airport, Kolkata (~340 km)
travel.railway: Malda Court railway station, ~0.35 km; Malda Town railway station (MLDT) nearby
travel.road: Ramakrishna Mission Road, Mokdumpur, English Bazar, Malda 732101; on Rathbari area

visitor_information.opening_hours: 6:00 AM-5:00 PM daily per most local listings; one listing says closing at 8:00 PM (conflict flag: verify)
